note: Pre-registered specification for Phase 8: Portfolio, Execution Economics & Adaptive Trade Management. Tests whether post-entry management policies (adaptive holding, breakeven stops, cutting deteriorating trades, partial exits, and portfolio correlation controls) convert the Phase 7 conditional edge into robust net expectancy after transaction costs.

entryBaselines.ENTRY_CONTROL: All generated candidate signals admitted (take-all baseline)

postEntryStates.description: Elapsed hold < 1 hour, excursions within initial noise band
Elapsed hold >= 1 hour, normal progression, |MFE| < 0.5 R
MFE >= +0.5 R, position demonstrating strong directional edge
Previously favorable, but no new MFE peak established for >= 2 hours
MAE <= -0.5 R while MFE < +0.2 R (trade moved straight into adverse territory)
Opposing trend direction or opposing strategy signal detected
Terminal state: order executed and position closed

managementPolicies.description: Production CONTROL management: 4h max hold, standard stop/target, standard trailing (0.50/0.25)
Move stop loss to entry price (breakeven) once MFE >= +0.5 R
Exit early at 2h if state is DETERIORATING (MAE <= -0.5 R and MFE < +0.2 R)
Adaptive holding: extend to 12h if FAVORABLE (MFE >= +0.5 R), exit at 2h if DETERIORATING
At +1.0 R, close 50% of position (locking half profit), move stop to breakeven on remaining 50% and trail to 12h
Tight trailing stop: activate at 0.30 ROI, giveback 0.15 ROI
Adaptive Composite: adaptive hold (favorable to 12h, deteriorating cut at 2h) + Breakeven stop at +0.5 R MFE + tight trailing
